evidence.quote: Information received since the Federal Open Market Committee met in January indicates that the economy continues to contract.
the Committee sees some risk that inflation could persist for a time below rates that best foster economic growth and price stability in the longer term.
anticipates that economic conditions are likely to warrant exceptionally low levels of the federal funds rate for an extended period.
the Committee decided to purchase up to $300 billion of longer-term Treasury securities over the next six months.
the Federal Reserve will employ all available tools to promote economic recovery and to preserve price stability.

parsed.rationale: The statement announces a massive expansion of asset purchases, including Treasuries, alongside extended near-zero rate guidance. It also describes a contracting economy and downside inflation risks, making it an explicitly and forcefully dovish document.
